name: place des Vosges
locality: 3rd arrondissement of Paris; 4th arrondissement of Paris; Quartier de l'Arsenal; Quartier des Archives
text: The Place des Vosges (French: [plas de voʒ]; lit. 'Vosges Square'), originally the Place Royale ('Royal Square'), is the oldest planned square in Paris, just before the Place Dauphine. It is located in the Marais district, and it straddles the dividing-line between the 3rd and 4th arrondissements.
